name: 77 K microwave insertion-loss measurement of a 4 GHz YBCO filter
plain_name: 77 K microwave insertion-loss measurement of a 4 GHz YBCO filter
description: Measure cryogenic bandpass transmission of a superconducting sapphire microstrip filter for low-loss microwave receiver technology; this is distinct from IR/THz photometry.

sources.citation: Sabataitis et al., YBCO High-Temperature Superconducting Filters on M-Plane Sapphire Substrates

reported_equipment: NASA/CWRU reported 77 K filter transmission setup

requirements.rationale: The reported filter characterization is at 77 K.
The documented bandpass center is 4.0 GHz.
RF transmission launches, coax and measurement readout are indispensable.

missing_information: Network-analyzer bandwidth around the center frequency, de-embedding, connector power handling and the exact cryostat model are not given in the inspected abstract. The source's measured insertion loss is an observation, not a guarantee.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
